What\'s encrypted — your bookmarks and backed-up files
Are my bookmarks and backed-up files encrypted?
Yes. Everything is scrambled on this device before it leaves — every bookmark, and every file you back up. The server only ever stores data it can\'t read.
Can Firedown or anyone else read my files?
No. Only your recovery code can unlock them, and it never leaves your device. Not us, not the people who run the servers, not anyone who steals a copy of them: they hold scrambled data and no key.
What does the server actually see?

Scrambled pieces of your files, how big they are, and when they arrived — plus a random account number your device works out from your recovery code, never a name or email. File names, types and previews are encrypted too, inside a sealed list only your device can open. The server never learns what a file is called, let alone what\'s in it.
A key generated on your device. It\'s the one and only thing that can decrypt your bookmarks and your backed-up files — on this device or a new one.
What if I lose my recovery code?

Your bookmarks and backed-up files can\'t be recovered — not by you, and not by us, because we never had the key. There is no password reset, and any storage credit you\'ve bought is reachable only with the code. Save it somewhere safe; a password manager is ideal.
Do I need an account or email?
No. There\'s no sign-up, email, or phone number — just the recovery code. Nothing personal is tied to your bookmarks or your files.
What if I don\'t want to use sync?
Sync is optional and off by default. You can always export your bookmarks to a file and import them later, with no server involved.
Can I back up Safe Folder files?
No — files in the Safe Folder never leave this device. They\'re excluded from Cloud Backup, the download-list backup and sending. To back one up, move it out of the Safe Folder first.

What\'s encrypted, and why your recovery code matters

Each download you back up is encrypted on this device before it leaves it — the server only ever stores scrambled bytes it can\'t read. Cloud Backup uses the same recovery code as bookmark sync: it\'s the only key, on this device or a new one, and it can\'t be recovered if lost.\n\nThere\'s no account, email, or sign-up. Your local Safe Folder is unrelated and never leaves this device.
